narrative.overview: Tempo is a plain, honest page of the day. Light paper for what is open or being edited, solid colour for time that is known, diagonal hatching for time not yet labeled, all on near-black. The ledger describes, it never judges. The system is flat; depth comes from tone, never shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas, light paper panels, saturated pastel Activity blocks.
Hatching always and only means Untracked.
One accent, lime #C6F432, used sparingly for "you are here" and "act now".
Space Grotesk everywhere, tabular figures for every time and duration.
Big rounded shapes; pills for actions.
Chronological 00–24 strips instead of charts that rank or score.

rules.name: The Hatch Means Unknown Rule
rules.body: Diagonal hatching is reserved for Untracked time and the open Lap's panel. Never use it as decoration.

rules.name: The One Lime Rule
rules.body: Lime marks the current place or the one action that matters now. At most one lime fill per screen besides Activity colours.

rules.name: The Paper Is Live Rule
rules.body: Light paper surfaces hold what is open or being changed. Settled lists live on Night.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every clock time and duration uses tabular figures so columns of times align and live timers don't jitter.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Do not add box shadows, elevation tints or glows. If something needs to stand forward, put it on paper.

dos: Do use the Activity's own colour for its block, strip segment and swatch; ink text on top.
Do show every time in the zone it was lived in, and both zones when a Record crosses them.
Do keep copy descriptive: "Logged Errands 08:42–10:06", "7h 27m a day", "Untracked · 20m".
Do keep touch targets at least 48dp and give strips and blocks screen-reader labels.
donts: Don't use evaluative or framing words: habit, session, streak, goal, focus, productive, work, most active, score.
Don't add shadows, gradients (other than hatching), glassmorphism or glow.
Don't use hatching for anything but Untracked time and the open Lap.
Don't load fonts from Google Fonts or any CDN; Space Grotesk ships in assets/fonts.
Don't rank Activities or show "top" lists outside the watch tile's three slots.
